messages.subject: Error adding text using geom_text() to polygon plot (map) of the USA
parts:
I created a map of the USA with colours that illustrate the intensity of usage of a database. I would like to add text at specific locations but I receive the following error message on the last line of the code shown here. 

Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the dataProblems:centers, lat, Usage

The data are too large to include but I have printed out at as comments.  Seems simple. 

Thank you for any help. 

Mary
